test_cases:
S = [[None, None, None, 9.9], [None, None, None, None]]
assert np.allclose(poisson_adjusted_moments(S, 10.0, 3), target)

S = [[3.1, None, 4.2, None], [2.2, 7.7, None, None], [5.5, None, 1.9, 8.8]]
assert np.allclose(censored_poisson_densities(S, 9.0, 1), target)

S = [[None, 11.6], [None, None], [4.4, None]]
assert np.allclose(censored_poisson_densities(S, 12.0, 3), target)

S = [[0.6, None, 7.9, 0.8], [None, None, 1.1, 9.4], [0.5, 6.6, None, 0.9], [2.2, None, 0.7, 5.1]]
assert np.allclose(censored_shen_estimates(S, 10.0, 1), target)

S = [[None, 5.9, None, 4.8], [None, None, 3.9, None], [5.5, None, None, 2.7]]
assert np.allclose(censored_shen_estimates(S, 6.0, 3), target)

S = [[0.6, None, 7.9, 0.8], [None, None, 1.1, 9.4], [0.5, 6.6, None, 0.9]]
assert np.allclose(nbd_censored_log_likelihood(S, 10.0, 1, 0.08, 0.6), target)

S = [[None, 5.9, None, 4.8], [None, None, 3.9, None], [5.5, None, None, 2.7]]
assert np.allclose(nbd_censored_log_likelihood(S, 6.0, 3, 0.12, 1e6), target)
